plan.description: The Tech-Lead design / implementation plan under review (component_map, api_contracts, ADRs, infra notes, etc.).

ba_brief.description: The epic + stories the plan must satisfy; enables criteria-coverage findings.

idempotency_key.description: Stable key; same key + same plan must yield the same verdict.
